verdict.rationale: Motion is a SaaS productivity and scheduling app, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or privacy settings. The 'Time Tracking' pricing item is a work time-tracking feature, not usage telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
